title: Great tour, highly recommend.
text: Our tour guide, Chema, was fantastic. He was very informative and made the tour very enjoyable. I would highly recommend him.
author: chrishR7971HV

title: Very interesting tour of Girona
text: We had a great tour with Anatoli.  He was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. Girona has a very interesting history and is well worth a visit.
author: 164jaredr

title: Fun and yum
text: This was a terrific experience.  Go hungry! There is a lot to eat and it's good! We can't wait to try to cook paella at home.
author: adrianne_s

title: Ancient Girona
text: Luis was generous with his time and knowledge. He enhanced our visit with modifications perfectly tailored to our sensibilities.
author: Kevin_E

title: Great tour and even better tour guide (Marco)
text: This was a great tour and our tour guide Marco made the experience one to remember. I really enjoyed his insight about Girona, Pals and surrounding attractions. He is patient while we took pictures and answered all of our questions. He has a great personality and really makes sure that everyone is comfortable and enjoying themselves. Highly recommend this tour and Marco even more.
author: Jstsavd

title: Excellent Tour of Girona
text: Miquel Arnau was a great tour guide. He was knowledgeable, funny, a good driver, and very friendly. We had a great time with him and would strongly recommend him!
author: 824willl

title: Wonderful!
text: Arnau kindly offered to take me to Girona, a lovely mediaeval city next to Barcelona. Arnau is a very talented guide with heaps of charisma. There was no question I threw at him that he didn’t have an interesting historical anecdote. Highly recommend !
author: nonghorb

title: Private tour of Girona
text:
Our private tour guide NURIA picked up us promptly at 9am from our hotel in Barcelona.
Nuria was Excellent, Fantastic in explaining to us the history and showing us the sights of Girona.
I big thanks to her, for us having a great trip to Girona.
